name: setting-row-checkbox
title: SettingRowCheckbox
description: Padded settings-row composition for an editable Checkbox group and its non-interactive saved-value readout.

intent.summary: Padded settings-row composition for an editable Checkbox group and its non-interactive saved-value readout.
useWhen: A settings card needs an independent multi-select Checkbox group as one padded row item.
The same settings card needs to display the saved selected values without interactive checkbox controls in view mode.
avoidWhen: The Checkbox group is not part of a settings-row surface; compose ds-checkbox-group directly.
Exactly one option may be selected; use component:ds-setting-row-radio.
The setting is a single immediate on/off choice; use component:ds-setting-row-toggle.
accessibility: Pass the settings heading as the row label. Do not pass CheckboxGroup's form label; the row owns the visible heading and points the slotted group at it with aria-labelledby.
Keep each Checkbox's label, checked state, name, value, and dsChange owned by the application. Leave the Checkbox group slotted in view and edit; the row hides it in view.
Do not add a second interaction layer to the row; each Checkbox owns its own focus and activation while settings usage keeps hasInteractionFill false.
View presentation exposes readable label, saved selected-value copy, and optional supporting copy without checkbox semantics, checkbox controls, or a focus target.
states: The row is a neutral padded composition; selected, focus, mixed, and inactive states belong to the slotted Checkboxes without a choice-list hover or pressed wash.
The owning application handles dsChange on each Checkbox and supplies valueLabel by joining the currently selected option labels.
Heading, saved-value choice, and slotted Checkbox group stay mounted. presentation reflects on the host so view/edit is CSS visibility only; do not swap Host children or ngIf the group.

View presentation hides the slotted Checkbox group with ::slotted host CSS and shows the saved selected values plus optional consequence copy. Omit description on the row and on each Checkbox when there is no supporting copy; view then shows only the selected-value labels. The group stays in the tree.
responsiveBehavior: The row never exceeds its parent width; the slotted Checkbox group keeps option copy in the flexible column and wraps descriptions when needed.

styling.rationale: The row uses the shared settings-row inline inset so view and edit copy share the same 16px origin, and zeros host padding-block because the heading, choice, and checkbox options already own vertical spacing. The heading is row-owned CSS, not CheckboxGroup's form label or control section-heading recipe. Checkbox owns option geometry.

protected.reason: Keep space-200 inline inset in view and edit, with no extra host padding-block.
